participant_id.Description: BIDS label from the release patient code (UMHS-0028 -> sub-UMHS0028, same label as in NEMAR nm000444)

source_id.Description: Patient code in the release (public pseudonym of the Michigan high-resolution EEG database)

ilae_class_paper.Description: ILAE outcome class, Lin et al. 2024 Table 1

ilae_release.Description: PatientInfo.ILAE as released (the release README describes the patients as one Engel I and one Engel III outcome)

seizure_focus_paper.Description: Seizure focus (hemisphere, region), Lin et al. 2024 Table 1 (R/L = right/left, T = temporal)

soz_resection_percent_paper.Description: Percent of the seizure onset zone resected, Lin et al. 2024 Table 1

definitive_surgery_paper.Description: Non-palliative definitive surgery (>= 80% SOZ resected), Lin et al. 2024 Table 1

total_hfo_count.Description: Total HFO count: Lin et al. 2024 Table 1; equals the number of HFO entries in PatientInfo.HFO of the release

n_rv_channels.Description: PatientInfo.Electrodes.RVn (contacts in the resected volume per the release)

related_raw_dataset.Description: NEMAR dataset with the raw recordings of this patient, if any
